name.value: Ted and Mary Greig Rhododendron Garden

description.value: The Ted and Mary Greig Rhododendron Garden is a municipal garden in Vancouver operated by the Vancouver Parks Board, celebrated for its extensive collection of rhododendrons and azaleas. Set within one of Canada's most iconic park systems, it offers a peaceful botanical detour for cyclists riding through the city. The garden is publicly accessible and free to enter, making it a low-effort stop on any urban cycling route.
